selection.overall: EA’s printed overall (FIFA 09–23); FIFA 98–08 print none and are chain-linked to the next title through the players both have
selection.card: The skills of that year, moved together until the game shows that overall
selection.bestVersion: Highest overall; ties: the latest title
selection.legends: Best versions shown 85+: players who are not in the catalog, and catalog players whose card today shows less; of a catalog nation; the club of that title when it is in the catalog
selection.primes: Catalog players whose best version shows more than their card today: any gain
selection.year: The year of the ratings: the snapshot date (FIFA 15–23), the year before the title’s number (FIFA 98–14)
selection.borrowed: Composure (FIFA 11–16), foot and weak foot (early titles): the player’s nearest version that has one
